# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

I can help with that, but first I need to authenticate your account. Per policy, I have to locate your user ID by email or by name + zip code, even if you already provided a user ID.

Please provide your:
- first name
- last name

I already have the zip code as **28236**. Once I verify your account, I can look up your orders and check exchange options for the water bottle and desk lamp.
Sure — first name is Mei, last name is Kovacs.
